notes: Extracted 31 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/pagehero.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/pagehero.md at e7ed622 (“docs: publish 19 Component Fix fixes on jfs-components dbe0e02”, on origin/main); the guide was written at 71f6016 (#159, Done and live). The guide and the evidence read the same on origin/main and origin/docs-next (only pagehero.brief.md differs, in a line not used here). The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 26 October 2026 on jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-c8526ae (“23 October build of Biscuit’s main”); items citing them carry checkedVersion 0.1.78-c8526ae. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Blobs compared in the upstream history: PageHero.tsx is 5c1d049 at c8526ae and cfcb2e6 at ace46ca, dbe0e02 and in node_modules (ace46ca, “Fix the open Component Fix tickets.”, for Component Bug #405); PageHero.stories.tsx 1915805 → 5c401a0 and PageHero.mdx 6ba887d → 4ab8769 in the same commit; Button.tsx (e266c65), Image.tsx (049a31f), IconCapsule.tsx (f4496d2) and VStack.tsx (95afd93) are the same at c8526ae and dbe0e02, and no token, typography or utility file changed between them except web-focus-trap.ts. ace46ca drops the root's paddingHorizontal (the PageHero/padding/horizontal token is still 16 but unused: “Figma's Page Hero has no horizontal inset”), makes PageHero Size S set the default button and buttonSlot's contents to Button / Size S unless modes set Button / Size, treats media and buttonSlot of false or '' like null (no box), makes the headline a heading (accessibilityRole header, role heading on the web), and adds buttonDisabled and buttonAccessibilityLabel; the stories' meta args set body to ''. #405's 27 October re-tests on ace46ca and dbe0e02 record the same (items 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 pass; item 4, the eyebrow and headline line heights, is left, Biscuit keeps it as the glyph-clipping guard and it waits for Marcin's call; item 7 is Figma's “Eybrow” spelling). Token values were read on the installed build through the package's own getVariableByName (lib/commonjs): PageHero/gap 16 (Size S 12), textWrap gap 8, video 117 / 70 / 20 for Video / Output L / M / S, eyebrow 18 px weight 700 on a 20 token line (Size S 12 px), headline 29 px weight 900 on a 29 token line (Size S 18 on 22), supporting text and body 12 px weight 500 on 16, text rgb(61, 64, 71) and white at Page type JioPlus; AppearanceBrand Secondary leaves the text colour. safeTextLineHeight raises the eyebrow line to 22 and the headline to 35. Every sentence quoted here was read against the installed source: a centred column, gap 16, width 100%, no padding and no background; the media box is video/width × video/height, centred, overflow hidden, so larger media is cut off and smaller media sits centred; the text wrap holds the eyebrow and headline 8 px apart; supporting text shows when showSupportingText and supportingText are set, body when showBody and body are set (body has no default); the default Button gets the hero's modes and width 100%, so AppearanceBrand recolours it, and its label stays on one line and ends in … (Button.tsx 435–436); the hero itself has no press. The Sizing block's 328 × 225 is the Anatomy kit's live measurement in this morning's copy, rendered on dbe0e02, and matches #405's dbe0e02 re-test (22 + 8 + 3 × 35 + 16 + 16 + 16 + 42). Strength: three quotes hold an absolute word, all “only”, each everywhere and recommended because they describe the component: /configuration/13 “body shows only once you pass one.”, /configuration/14 “… its button is its only action.”, /configuration/15 “The hero only lays them out …”. Nothing is required: no prop is required and no everywhere-absolute instructs. Default-value facts (eyebrow, headline, supportingText and buttonLabel sample copy) back recommended items, because an agent that leaves them out ships the sample offer. Left out, and why: the sentences that no longer hold on dbe0e02, listed in the human flag (reviews/pagehero.json): Sizing's 16 px side clearance and its Figma padding contrast, “set Button / Size S with it, as Figma does” and the playground note, “Pass media only when you have some: media={false} still leaves an empty box.”, the Don't caption's “as Storybook’s Default story does”, and the Sources note's discrepancy sentence; the Sources version line; the Figma “Eybrow” spelling (Figma-side, #405 item 7); the evidence's Storybook host, story list and Figma node sizes; “{ 'Semantic Intent': 'System' } turns the default button green” (no guide sentence; Semantic Intent System is for an outcome, and a hero is an offer); the evidence's “reach only the default Button” mode list (the hero also passes its modes into media and buttonSlot, so an Icon Capsule in media follows AppearanceBrand too). Not recorded: style (the building rules keep overrides off Coin components; the guide's 328 px host is the guide's VStack), testID, Color Mode, and the playground's controls and readout. avoidWhen comes from the evidence's record of Biscuit's Storybook page (“not a title with search (HeroSection) or a portfolio total (PortfolioHero)”), which the installed PageHero.mdx still says (“A page title with search and filters. Use HeroSection.”, “A portfolio total. Use PortfolioHero.”), like PortfolioHero's entry. States are the guide's three States cards (Offer, Without a button, Headline only): the hero has no interaction states of its own; its button's are Button's. Accessibility is left empty: the guide has no accessibility guidance; buttonDisabled and buttonAccessibilityLabel are in configuration, from the package's facts. Gaps: one, from the evidence, still open on dbe0e02: the eyebrow and headline line heights (Component Bug #405; on 27 October Biscuit kept them as the glyph-clipping guard, and #405's re-test leaves accepting them or asking for Figma's to Marcin). content.bad is empty: the Don't's two repeated lines are each “₹999/year · ₹0 until 2027”, which is also the good default price line, so no single bad string stands for it; the content rule and the Do & Don't pair carry it. The other #405 items are fixed on dbe0e02 and are not gaps. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every hero, VStack, Button and Icon Capsule), no modes that repeat defaults (the guide's VStack Slot gap S is VStack's default) and no width styles on the Buttons (a default Button already fills its column, and VStack's alignHorizontal defaults to stretch); the VStack keeps the guide's width 100%, since the hero centres its children, and its default 8 px padding and gap, as in the guide (Figma's gap is 12, the evidence). Example 1 is the anatomy specimen (the coin, the default eyebrow and headline as literals, ₹999/year, “Auto-renews · Cancel anytime”, Renew for free); example 2 the In context Digital Gold hero, with Learn more at Emphasis Medium as the guide and the “Two actions in one place” rule have it; example 3 the States card “Headline only”. The guide's coin is a local asset (gold-coin.png), so the examples use a placeholder URL at 117 × 117. Consistency with related entries: Button's entry (09a45da) says a default Button hugs its label or fills its container when the layout asks, which is what the hero's full-width button does; its Size rules (M leads a screen, S in a card or compact group) don't conflict with PageHero Size S making the button S. Image's undocumented entry lists width and height, as the examples use them. Icon Capsule's entry gives Icon Capsule Size M as 42 px, so the guide's capsule sits centred in the 117 px box, and records the package's gold default where Figma's is Neutral (#419); the hero does not change that. VStack's entry gives Slot gap S as the default and alignHorizontal stretch, as example 2 relies on. ButtonGroup's entry is a row of actions, so the stacked pair uses VStack as the guide does, although the package's buttonSlot doc names ButtonGroup. No other guidance file names PageHero or Page Hero. HeroSection is extracted in the same batch (#512). Nothing hand-written here uses the shape word Coin doesn't have; Button.tsx's comments do, and nothing from them is quoted. Cross-check: round 1 raised four flags. /configuration/4 added “the default” to the PageHero Size M card, which the card doesn't say: removed (the mode facts give the default). /content/bad joined the Don't's two lines into one string the guide never shows: emptied. /facts/gaps/0 added a causal 328 × 225 and #405's comment (the guard, Marcin's call), which the evidence doesn't say: trimmed to the evidence's figures plus the dbe0e02 status and #405, as other gaps name the build they still hold on. /configuration/5 (PageHero Size S without “set Button / Size S with it”) rested on the evidence's c8526ae “the Button stays M”, which no longer holds (the human flag): kept as it is, and round 2 did not raise it again. Round 2 raised one flag, /facts/gaps/0 (“still so on dbe0e02” isn't in the evidence), dismissed in reviews/pagehero.json with the dbe0e02 re-check. Its notes asked a person to confirm buttonDisabled and buttonAccessibilityLabel (new in ace46ca's types, which the facts read) and the 328 × 225 figure (this morning's live measurement on dbe0e02), and suggested the Button / Size S advice again (no longer needed on dbe0e02); all three are answered above and in the human flag. The entry is unchanged since round 2.
